HIDMaestro third-party notices
==============================

HIDMaestro bundles the following third-party component. This notice is
embedded in HIDMaestro.Core.dll and written to disk alongside the
component whenever HIDMaestro deploys it.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
usbip-win2 (version 0.9.7.5)
https://github.com/vadimgrn/usbip-win2
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Used as the USB transport for HIDMaestro's composite USB personas
(profiles that present USB Audio Class interfaces alongside HID). A
Windows audio endpoint requires a driver-backed USB device, which no
user-mode API can create, so HIDMaestro speaks the USB/IP protocol to
usbip-win2's virtual host controller. Every device behavior remains in
HIDMaestro's own user-mode code.

The redistributed binaries are the upstream release assets, unmodified.
HIDMaestro deploys the one matching the machine's architecture.

USBip-0.9.7.5-x64-release.exe, SHA256:
6f429dd47cfe371dbd275ced5fc512494918683b07853cbdf2d8c25e4274fd74

USBip-0.9.7.5-arm64-release.exe, SHA256:
0dc47a895ab6dddcfa5ef4cd12014f9f3515770bec706773c9e9f5f876ebccb5
